digest.component_or_area: store git operations (gitutil, lock acquisition, command execution)
propositions: Local git call sites lack unified contention handling; concurrent rebar agents contend on shared .git/index.lock and ref locks, surfacing errors instead of absorbing transient conflicts

A per-store advisory lock plus bounded jittered retry on git lock signatures must serialize index-mutating operations at the store execution seam (_with_index_lock_retry), with silent recovery for transient conflicts and one actionable error naming the lock file on budget exhaustion
Every local-only git call site must be bounded with a watchdog timeout (120s for write operations, 300s for read-heavy metrics paths) to prevent unbounded stalls while holding the store write lock
Contention sleeps must be jittered uniformly [0.75, 1.25] to de-synchronize competing processes under high concurrency, replacing fixed 50ms/100ms intervals in _acquire_fcntl and _acquire_mkdir
